_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.dem::16, which this run REWROTE. The claim used to say only that 'VTK output goes through the core KM.VtkOutput class and the core vtk_output_process module', with a Signal about unsupported geometries carried over from 2026-06-01 and never executed against DEM. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3: the core vtk_output_process cannot be attached to a DEM SpheresPart at all. Measured: output_control_type 'step' raises RuntimeError 'Error: STEP not found in process info of SpheresPart.' and 'time' raises 'Error: TIME not found in process info of SpheresPart.', both from kratos/controllers/output_controller.cpp:81, during Initialize and before any step. Probing the same ProcessInfo after Initialize returns shows TIME present and STEP absent, so the cause is the order in which DEM_analysis_stage.Initialize calls AnalysisStage.Initialize (and its Check) relative to populating that ProcessInfo. The DEM-native post_vtk_option is not a workaround either: DEMApplication.dem_vtk_output does 'from pyevtk import hl' at module scope and pyevtk is not a Kratos dependency; the fixture asserts that as a biconditional so it is correct with or without pyevtk installed. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying DEMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON=/mnt/kratos-tier2/kv/bin/python (the 28-application source build). The repo venv wheel does not import at all on this host (GLIBC_2.32 against a 2.31 system) and /usr/bin/python3 carries no DEMApplication, so pointing this anywhere else SKIPS rather than passes. Every deck is written into a fresh TemporaryDirectory and driven through DEMAnalysisStage in a CHILD process: Kratos logs from C++ and buffers it, so an in-process capture would miss every DEM line, and a Finalize()d DEM stage cannot be probed from python without segfaulting. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): see the module docstring -- the mutation changes the INPUT only, never an assertion, so every deck is still really executed against Kratos. Verified 2026-08-07: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with probe_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the named probe lines flip and the trailing =ok line disappears. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_vtk_output_process_cannot_attach_to_spherespart && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py, then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py. NOTE ON forbid_in_output: the sentinel is FIXTURE_FAILED, not MISMATCH. The runner's matcher is case-insensitive substring, so forbidding 'MISMATCH' also matches the 'probe_mismatches=0' line this fixture prints on SUCCESS, and every passing run would be recorded as failed. Found by running these fixtures through scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py rather than by hand. RESTORED HALF (2026-08-07, same day): this fixture originally covered only the ProcessInfo failure, because the older claim's quoted message -- 'Modelpart contains elements or conditions with geometries for which no VTK-output is implemented!' -- returned 0 files under grep -r -a -F and was judged a candidate fabrication. It is REAL. libKratosCore.so holds it as two adjacent literals, 'Modelpart contains elements or conditions with ' and 'geometries for which no VTK-output is implemented!', with a runtime interpolation slot between them, so the whole sentence matches nothing whether written with one space or two. Driving KM.VtkOutput directly on a one-element model part prints it: measured for CylinderParticle2D and for SphericParticle3D, both reporting cell type 30, from kratos/input_output/vtk_output.cpp:451. The two new probes defend that half by execution. MUTATION for those probes: the DEM particle is replaced by a plain Element2D3N, a geometry the writer DOES support, so the message that must appear does not.
